SELECT m.id, m.message_type, m.title, m.content, m.event_type, m.entity_type, m.entity_id, m.sender_id, m.sender_name, m.create_time, COALESCE(mu.read_flag, 0) AS read_flag FROM sys_message m LEFT JOIN sys_message_user mu ON m.id = mu.message_id AND mu.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.del_flag = 0 AND ( m.message_type = 2 OR (m.message_type = 1 AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) OR mu.id IS NOT NULL )
AND m.event_type = #{query.eventType}
AND COALESCE(mu.read_flag, 0) = 0
ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
